verdict.rationale: DeepInfra offers async/batch-friendly 'flex' inference tier explicitly aimed at bulk, non-production workloads like data enrichment and evaluations, which supports bulk operations at the API level, but there's no documented batch API, bulk file upload, or job queue mechanism for processing many items in a single call. missing for 10: dedicated batch/bulk API endpoint, bulk file/job submission mechanism, evidence of concurrent multi-item processing limits or throughput guarantees, independent confirmation of bulk workload handling.
